chapter.title: Farm and Seasons
subtitle: Nine rows, a calendar, and one machine that ignores it.
What grows when, what beats the frost, and where the flour comes from.

images.hover: Thirty-two of these is Act I's flour.
Phytogro, and no season at all.

quests.title: Break Ground With a Hoe
quests.subtitle: Water within four blocks, or nothing.
description: Halden: "Josie's patch was nine rows. I counted them every spring for eleven years and never once put a spade in one."
Craft a &aStone Hoe&r and till a strip of grass beside the lake. Farmland within four blocks of water stays dark, and dark farmland grows.

quests.title: Grow and Cut Thirty-Two Wheat
quests.subtitle: Bram's millstone eats it by the sack.
description: Plant &awheat seeds&r on wet farmland and leave them until the stalks go gold before you cut.
Crops grow while you are elsewhere. Put the composter in, hunt the wild crops, or go and see Bram — do not stand and watch the rows.
Act I, step 8 wants sixteen flour and eight bread off this patch.

quests.title: Craft a Calendar and Read the Date
quests.subtitle: Twelve pages. Four seasons. One rule.
description: Hold the &aCalendar&r to read the season and the day. Every crop here is tagged to a season, and out of season it does not grow one stage. &cIt is not broken — it is waiting.&r
A season is &b27 days&r long, so the three quests below are a year-long thread. Leave them running and play the rest of the valley around them.
&bSpring&r: carrot, potato, strawberry. &bSummer&r: melon, tomato, corn. &bAutumn&r: pumpkin, beetroot, amaranth.

quests.title: Bring In the Spring Crops
quests.subtitle: Carrots, potatoes, strawberries.
description: Carrots and potatoes came out of Marnie's sack. &aStrawberries&r grow wild in the meadow — break the plants for seed, then plant all three and bring in sixteen of each.
Wheat is spring-fertile in this pack on purpose, so Act I is not waiting on July.

quests.title: Bring In the Summer Crops
quests.subtitle: Corn stands taller than Pip.
description: Cut sixteen &amelon slices&r and grow sixteen &atomatoes&r and sixteen &acorn&r while the calendar reads summer.
Corn grows two blocks high. Leave it headroom or it never tops out.

quests.title: Bring In the Autumn Crops
quests.subtitle: Pumpkin, beetroot, amaranth. Then frost.
description: Sow &abeetroot&r, &apumpkin&r and &aamaranth&r in autumn and get them in before the first frost.
Oda opens Act III on these same rows and wants the granary full by winter.

quests.title: Learn What Winter Stops
quests.subtitle: Everything outdoors, and quietly.
description: In winter a seasonal crop sits at the stage you left it and never says so. &cIt is not broken.&r
Only &aVibrant Quartz Glass&r counts as a greenhouse roof here, and it wants cyanite: see the &6Reactor&r chapter.

quests.title: Fill a Composter for Bone Meal
quests.subtitle: Seeds, stalks, everything bruised.
description: Build a &aComposter&r and feed it every scrap off the patch until bone meal drops out of the bottom.
Bone meal is the base of compost, of rich soil and of phytogro.

quests.title: Bring In Four Wild Crops
quests.subtitle: They are already growing out there.
description: Marnie: "Cabbage grows wild along the treeline. I have walked past it for ten years because I like the walk."
Josie's seed tin already holds cabbage, tomato and rice — plant those at home. Only the &aonion&r is still out there, in the long grass on the forest edge.
Harvest eight of each.
Marnie hands eight onions across the counter on the first quest of &6Cooking and Brewing&r if you would rather not walk the treeline.

quests.title: Stand a Silo Beside the Rows
quests.subtitle: Nine planks. Holds one harvest.
description: Craft a &aWooden Silo&r and set it at the end of the patch. It swallows one crop in bulk and hands it back a stack at a time.
For drawers and barrels, see the &6Power&r chapter.

quests.title: Grow the Four Thermal Crops
quests.subtitle: Three of them work through winter.
description: These four grow wild. Walk the meadows and the field edges until you find &abarley&r, &aspinach&r, &asadiroot&r and &abell pepper&r standing in the grass, break them for seed, then plant and harvest sixteen of each.
The first three keep growing outdoors in December. Bell pepper stops at the frost.

quests.title: Set a Berry Hedge and a Cabbage Row
quests.subtitle: Two things the frost never reads.
description: Sweet berry bushes and cabbages both stay fertile through winter. Plant a hedge of one and a row of the other.
Halden has kept a hedge since Act II. Ask him where the good bushes are.

quests.title: Make Eight Organic Compost
quests.subtitle: Right-click dirt with it for rich soil.
description: &aOrganic Compost&r is straw, tree bark, bone meal and one dirt on the grid. Straw and bark both come off a &aCutting Board&r — that is the first quest in &6Cooking and Brewing&r.
Crops on rich soil grow faster, and the block never needs tilling again.

quests.title: Mix Sixteen Phytogro
quests.subtitle: Sand, two apatite, one niter.
description: &aPhytogro&r is bone meal that works on everything, eight to a craft. Apatite and niter both come out of ordinary stone.
The insolator burns it, and it is the fastest road to a second harvest.

quests.title: Cut Sixteen Rice Panicles
quests.subtitle: Ankle-deep water. No tilling.
description: Plant rice in shallow water at the lake edge and cut the tops when they droop over.
Wisp wants twelve panicles in Act III. Grow the extra now and be early for once.

quests.title: Hang a Beehive Over the Rows
quests.subtitle: They work the patch for nothing.
description: Put a campfire under a wild nest before you shear it, or &cthe whole nest comes after you&r. Then craft a &aBeehive&r.
Bees push a pollinated crop up a stage. Three bottles of honey say the hive took.

quests.title: Build a Phytogenic Insolator
quests.subtitle: A field in one block, indoors.
description: The stretch goal of this chapter, and the only one that needs the tech lane. The &aInsolator&r takes seeds, water and phytogro and hands back the crop, and no season touches it.
It wants a machine frame and lumium gears: both roads to a frame are in the &6Thermal&r chapter.

quests.title: Grow Sixty-Four Wheat in Winter
quests.subtitle: Snow on the roof, flour in the sack.
description: Feed &awheat seeds&r and &aphytogro&r into the insolator while the calendar reads winter, and run it to sixty-four wheat.
Wheat cannot grow outdoors in December. This is the whole reason the machine exists.

rewards.title: Farm and Seasons
rewards.description: Next: Act V glazes a cold frame and grows four crops in February.
